plan: My private value is $15. In a first-price sealed bid auction with three bidders, I want to bid strategically. Since I only value the item at $15, I don't want to bid too high and risk losing money. However, I also want a chance of winning. I'll bid slightly above my value but not excessively, around $16-17, which gives me a small buffer while minimizing potential losses. This approach balances potential profit with risk management.
